"""Binding-quota worst case for the general min-cost-flow route."""
import sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import planning
from plan_worst import build
from common import validate
from planning import solve

def run(job, label):
    ctx = validate(job)
    active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
    t = time.time(); plan = solve(ctx, active); dt = time.time() - t
    print('%s resolved=%d cost=%d %.1fs maxrss=%.0fMB' % (label, plan['resolved'], plan['cost'], dt,
          resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss / 1024))

for nreq, noff, per in ((500, 500, 50), (1000, 1000, 50), (2000, 4000, 60), (4096, 8192, 32)):
    job = build(nreq, noff, per, quota_cap=2000)
    run(job, 'quota_cap=2000 nreq=%d noff=%d per=%d ->' % (nreq, noff, per))
PYEOF
timeout 1500 python3 tests/plan_worst2.py
